events.name: Bash
events.head: Check walker and chain state
events.input: $ cd /tmp/t242c; ls; for f in walk.pid chain.pid; do [ -f $f ] && { echo "$f=$(cat $f)"; ps -p $(cat $f) -o pid,etime,command | tail -1; }; done; ls -la /tmp/walk/ | grep 242; tail -5 walk-webinar.log; ls chain 2>/dev/null; date

events.text: Webinar walker finished with 0 findings. The chain is still running; checking its progress.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read chain summary and challenge walker progress
events.input: $ cd /tmp/t242c/chain; cat summary.txt | head -40; echo ---; tail -4 walk-challenge.log; ls -la walk-challenge.log; tail -3 walk-webinar.log; ls /tmp/walk | grep -i -E "chain|challenge|rsp"

events.text: Webinar passes in the chain too; challenge is walking now. While it runs, I'll check the failing probes for any Kie.ai line, and whether walk-ui.mjs writes report.json on a crash.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Scan chain logs for Kie and failures
events.input: $ cd /tmp/t242c/chain; grep -il kie *.log; echo ---; for f in probe-domain-chain probe-day1 probe-day2 probe-stack probe-context probe-tantra-reminders probe-workshop; do echo "== $f"; grep -iE "fail|error|✗|timeout" $f.log | head -4 | cut -c1-200; done

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect walker report writing and git state
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -nE "report\.json|writeFileSync|process\.on|catch \(|uncaught|unhandled|setTimeout\(.*exit" app/scripts/walk-ui.mjs | head -30; wc -l app/scripts/walk-ui.mjs; git log --oneline -3 -- app/scripts/walk-ui.mjs app/src/app/onboarding/centre/centre.tsx; git status --short app/scripts/walk-ui.mjs app/src/app/onboarding/centre/centre.tsx; git log origin/main..main --oneline | wc -l

events.text: Report-on-crash is already in place (walk-ui.mjs:61-69, commit feff025e). Next I'm checking the Kie.ai mention in probe-stack and whether the T-242 commits are already pushed.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check Kie lines and push state
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -i kie /tmp/t242c/chain/probe-stack.log | head -5 | cut -c1-200; echo ---; git fetch -q origin 2>&1|tail -1; for c in a1c8b18a a178675b feff025e; do echo "$c on origin: $(git branch -r --contains $c 2>/dev/null | grep -c 'origin/main')"; done; git log origin/main..main --oneline | head -20; echo; git rev-list --count main..origin/main

events.name: Bash
events.head: Wait for chain to finish both walkers
events.input: $ until grep -q "walk-rsp" /tmp/t242c/chain/summary.txt 2>/dev/null || ! ps -p 16831 >/dev/null; do sleep 30; done; tail -4 /tmp/t242c/chain/summary.txt; tail -2 /tmp/t242c/chain/walk-challenge.log /tmp/t242c/chain/walk-rsp.log 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-250

events.name: Bash
events.head: Verify webinar reports
events.input: $ for r in /tmp/walk/242-webinar/report.json /tmp/walk/1-webinar/report.json; do python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(open('$r'));j=d.get('jobs',[]);print('$r',len(d['findings']),'findings', sum(x['status']=='done' for x in j),'/',len(j),'jobs done', 'kie' in json.dumps(d['findings']).lower())"; done

events.text: Both webinar reports are confirmed. Now waiting for the chain's challenge and rsp walks.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Block until chain completes
events.input: $ until grep -q "walk-rsp" /tmp/t242c/chain/summary.txt 2>/dev/null || ! ps -p 16831 >/dev/null; do sleep 20; done; echo finished
